description: CommitSuite evaluation script, model card fill-out, and README updates. Depends on FEAT-001 (which centralizes diff_utils utilities). Creates scripts/evaluate_commitsuite.py to run OffHand's model on CommitSuite's CMG eval dataset (1000 examples) via Ollama and report BLEU/ROUGE-L/METEOR/valid-format/type-accuracy. Fills out the blank model card. Updates README with new commands.
steps: Step 1 — Read CommitSuite/CMG-eval_dataset/all_CMG.json to confirm its structure (url, hash, msg, message_type, description, modified_files[]{old_path, new_path, diff}, etc.) and verify the first few entries are valid for diff reconstruction.

Step 3 — Fill out commit-model-lora/README.md. Replace ALL 'More Information Needed' placeholders with real content drawn from: results.md (evaluation metrics), adapter_config.json (training hyperparameters), fine-tuning_Kaggle.ipynb (training setup), CommitBench_filter.ipynb (data pipeline), plan.md and MVP.md (project description). Sections to fill: Model Description, Direct Use, Training Data (CommitBench, CC BY-NC 4.0, HuggingFace Maxscha/commitbench), Training Procedure (LoRA r=16, Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct base, SFTTrainer, 2 epochs, SEQ_LEN=768), Evaluation Results (table from results.md), Framework versions (already correct: PEFT 0.21.0), Environmental Impact (Kaggle T4, ~2h), Citation (CommitBench paper ref from README).
Step 4 — Update hf_model_card/README.md with the same content as commit-model-lora/README.md (they serve the same purpose; keep them in sync).

Step 5 — Update README.md. Add a 'Evaluation' section or extend the existing one with: (a) how to run the new evaluate_commitsuite.py script with example command, (b) note that evaluate.py now reports METEOR and per-type metrics, (c) brief note about the CommitSuite benchmark comparison. Keep existing content intact — only additions, no deletions.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/evaluate_commitsuite.py exists and is syntactically valid Python
evaluate_commitsuite.py imports build_diff from commit_model.diff_utils and TYPE_RE, VALID_RE, extract_type from commit_model.diff_utils
evaluate_commitsuite.py reads from CommitSuite/CMG-eval_dataset/all_CMG.json by default
commit-model-lora/README.md contains no remaining 'More Information Needed' strings
commit-model-lora/README.md contains the evaluation results table from results.md
verification: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from commit_model.diff_utils import build_diff, TYPE_RE, VALID_RE, extract_type; print('imports OK')"
python -c "txt=open('commit-model-lora/README.md').read(); assert 'More Information Needed' not in txt, 'Found placeholder!'; print('model card OK')"
